people.name: Robert James Gabriel
people.title: Founder and CTO
people.alt: Robert James Gabriel, founder of Coffee & Fun
people.bio: Robert founded Coffee & Fun LLC and builds its apps, browser extensions and free web tools. He writes most of what appears on this blog, usually about accessibility, the awkward parts of shipping software, and whatever broke that week.

people.name: Courtney Hood
people.title: Head of Marketing
people.alt: Courtney Hood, head of marketing at Coffee & Fun
people.bio: Courtney leads marketing at Coffee & Fun LLC. She also coined Snoopification, which now has its own article on this blog.

people.name: Anna Brown
people.title: Support Agent
people.alt: Anna Brown, support agent at Coffee & Fun
people.bio: Anna is the support agent at Coffee & Fun LLC. If you have emailed us and got a real reply from a real person, that was probably her.
